summary: During the upgrade to AAP 2.6, IAM data (users, teams, organizations, memberships, roles) moves from automation controller and hub to platform gateway, with controller as the primary source; upgrading directly from latest 2.4 to 2.6 is recommended over going through 2.5.
questions: What happens to users and teams when upgrading to AAP 2.6?
Should I upgrade from 2.4 to 2.5 first or directly to 2.6?
Which service is the source of IAM data for platform gateway after upgrade?

answer_card.title: IAM data movement in the 2.6 upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
- Users, teams, organizations, memberships and roles move from automation controller and automation hub into **platform gateway**.
- Automation controller is the primary source of IAM data.
- Recommended path: upgrade the latest **2.4 directly to 2.6**, skipping 2.5, because it is less complex.
